thread:
Maya: quick sync — want a compact benchmark narrative for the launch post + webinar. Core ask: convince eng/product folks that Redwood gives predictable latency while cutting token $ by X% vs naive hosting. short and punchy.
Jonah: agree. we should pick 2–3 charts only. something that maps to buyer decisions: (1) per-token $ vs 95th latency scatter, (2) tail-latency CDF for typical workloads, (3) simple funnel that connects chart -> customer action (dedicated vs hosted).
Priya: can do. propose a pair of visuals: a condensed scatter with color by model variant, and a small CDF inset. I can mock in raw numbers — need the dataset shape.
Maya: data shape: mix of chat (avg seq 256) and generation (avg seq 1024), workload split 70/30. show baseline (open model standard infra), + Redwood caching + batching + quantization. target stat: cost per 100k tokens and p95 latency.
Carlos: I can export the perf matrix. uses: base infra (cpu+fp16), optimized (GPU w/ batching), Redwood recommended (KV cache + quant). I'll drop a CSV by EOD.
Elena: visual style: keep it minimal for post. one hero chart (scatter) + a micro-legend/annotation explaining the 3 levers (caching, batch, quant). prefer muted palette, highlight Redwood points in brand teal.
Sam: for the webinar landing, we need a micro narrative line: "Same quality, fewer dollars, predictable p95" — also a CTA for a quick econ calc. can we produce a little token-cost calculator snippet?
Jonah: yes — simple inputs: avg tokens per request, qps, % cached prefix. output: monthly cost estimate and recommended deployment (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Priya can build a mock table.
Priya: mock chart specs: scatter x=95th latency (ms), y=cost per 100k tokens (USD), point size = throughput. variants: baseline, optimized, redwood. add small CDF plot showing % requests under 200ms / 500ms. annotations: label the knee where cost spikes for low latency.
Maya: perfect. messaging bullets for post: 1) Redwood reduces unit cost by combining caching + batching + model selection; 2) predictable p95 keeps SLAs simple; 3) pick deployment mode based on stability/throughput needs. keep each bullet 8–12 words max.
Elena: drafting social visual copy: "Ship fast. Pay less. Keep your SLAs." will overlay on hero image with a small caption: "Real workload, real savings — live demo in webinar".
Jonah: webinar plan: 20m demo, 10m bench walkthrough, 15m Q&A. handoff: Maya to open, Carlos to run demo infra, Priya to explain charts, Jonah to close.
Sam: inbound routing: add a hidden form field on webinar sign-up to capture "expected monthly tokens" and "primary constraint (latency/cost/controls)" — route leads: latency-first -> sales AE for platform; cost-first -> growth SDR; privacy/regulatory -> solutions eng.
Maya: love that. make routing rules explicit here so eng can implement. Sam — write short mapping.
Sam: mapping: latency-first -> tag: LATENCY; assign: AE_LowLatency; cost-first -> tag: COST; assign: SDR_Cost; control/reg -> tag: REG; assign: SOL_ENG. will add to CRM playbook.
Carlos: infra note: for the demo, we'll run a 95/256/1024 mix to reflect the split. I'll provision a dedicated small pool and a fallback hosted model for load spikes.
Priya: timeline: mock visuals by tomorrow AM, final figures after Carlos CSV. draft charts will be tiny PNGs suitable for post + slide.
Elena: I'll prep hero and 2 slide templates (scatter + CDF). need copy strings from Jonah + Maya.
Maya: ownership recap: Carlos -> perf CSV & demo infra; Priya -> charts; Elena -> visuals; Jonah -> narrative bullets + webinar script; Sam -> inbound routing + CRM tags; Maya -> publish schedule + post approvals.
Jonah: copy bullets (first pass): "Predictable p95 with 30–50% lower per-token cost", "Smart caching and quantization that preserves output quality", "One API surface across hosted, dedicated, and private". feedback?
Priya: tweak 1: avoid a precise % until Carlos confirms. suggest: "Significant per-token cost reduction while keeping p95 within target".
Maya: good call. keep numbers out of hero copy. put a callout on the slide: "demo shows up to XX% improvements — details in blog".
Elena: noted. For social: short caption + 1-line CTA to register.
Sam: I'll wire the sign-up form with the extra fields and tags tonight. linking the routing doc here: https://internal/redwood/crms/routing - will update.
Carlos: uploaded CSV: /shared/perf/1726012345-bench.csv (link). contains columns: model_variant, seq_len, p50_ms, p95_ms, cost_per_100k.
Priya: grabbing it now. will prototype scatter with these columns.
Maya: deadline: draft post copy + visuals + webinar landing up by Fri EOD. if we hit that, soft social push next Tue, webinar Wed of next week.
Jonah: I'll assemble a 3-slide deck for dev preview.
Elena: ping me once copy is final, I'll drop assets in Figma component: "bench-hero-v1".
Maya: awesome. thanks everyone — close the loop here when you push assets. :raised_hands:
Carlos: will update once demo infra is ready.
Priya: chart mocks done -> /assets/bench/mock-scatter.png (will replace with final after styling).
Sam: routing playbook updated in CRM. will tag leads from webinar as discussed.
Jonah: prepping slide notes for the 10m bench walkthrough.
Maya: thread complete for now. we'll reconvene if any blockers.
